frozen_eye_source: design/proportions.json/eyes: centers and 0.049 m globe radius unchanged
notes: +Y is forward; eye child meshes are local to sphere-center aim pivots.
Upper/lower lids are separate closed quad patches. Fixed outer arcs, moving inner arcs stay on the same offset sphere.
Blink is evaluated nonlinearly on the sphere, not by linear shape-key interpolation through the eyeball.
At full closure both inner arcs share the exact meeting curve; outer mask/lid seam is an intentional attachment overlap.
Matte palette and clear cornea inspection material are diagnostic; final iris/shader/network lookdev and animatable controls follow separately.
